label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**Subject:** Re: Nia's hen

Hiya Beth,

Just you this time, I'm not touching the group one with a bargepole!

Only just landed back from Lagos so excuse me if this is a bit all over the place. I saw your message and I get it, honestly I do. Nobody wants a whole weekend of tiptoeing round each other in a cottage. I'm not having a go and I'm not on anyone's side. You and Lowri can sort that out between yourselves whenever you're ready. I just really, really want you there.

Nia rang me last week in tears asking if you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out yet. I didn't know what to say to her, Beth. You were the one sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad. She's never forgotten that. I don't think she'd ever say anything, but I know she'd feel it if you weren't there, and I think you would too.

So here's my idea. Skip the cottage on Friday if you'd rather. Just come for the Saturday. You'd only need to be in Tenby for about 6, and there's a train from Cardiff Central that's about two and a half hours. I'll pick you up from the station so you're not walking in on your own. I've got the twin room, so you can kip in with me Saturday night, no sharing with anyone awkward. Then it's the meal, a few drinks, back to ours. Done.

And please hang on before you send Lowri that £85. Just leave it for now. No point sorting money out while everyone's still prickly.

For what it's worth, I think Lowri's sorry really. She's just stubborn. Same as someone else I know 😉 Things got said on both sides at her 40th and I don't think either of you meant half of it.

Also, I swapped my Orlando with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, and you know how much I wanted that night stop! So I'm going to be a bit gutted if I've given up Disney and you're not even there 😂

We've got Margam on the 17th April and you're doing a reading. I'd love for the hen to be all of us together before the big day.

Have a think. No pressure, just let me know.

Love you lots,
Siân xx

reasons: The appeal omits 2019 and only hints that Bethan will regret missing the hen and Nia will remember her absence.
